Reference image 2 is an existing event illustration from this game: copy its ART STYLE (bold dark hand-drawn outlines, flat colours with soft cel shading, chunky cute chibi proportions) and the way the scene is cut out on a transparent background. The character's eyes look at the page.
Only the characters named in the SCENE appear - no other cats, no extra copies of anyone. No text, no letters, no numbers, no writing of any kind (drawings on paper are simple ink pictures, never words), no speech bubbles, no frame, no border. Truly transparent RGBA background: no checkerboard drawing, no white box, no wall or sky filling the frame, no cast shadow outside the small floor patch.
